title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks referenced by every published schema. Not a published file. Patterns avoid lookarounds so they behave the same in ECMAScript (ajv), Python re (jsonschema) and Rust regex (pydantic-core).

partialDate.title: PartialDate
partialDate.description: Calendar date with variable precision: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, years 1900-2099. Day ranges follow the month (Feb allows up to 29); leap years are not checked.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC, always with a Z suffix and optional fractional seconds up to microseconds.

airlineId.title: AirlineId
airlineId.description: Pipeline-assigned stable airline ID: 'al-' followed by a lowercase slug. Never an ICAO code, because ICAO codes get reused by different airlines over time.

airframeId.title: AirframeId
airframeId.description: Stable airframe ID: {manufacturer}-{programme}-{msn}, three lowercase alphanumeric segments. Hyphens and other punctuation are removed inside each segment so the ID always splits into exactly three parts. Never starts with 'al-', so it can't be confused with an airline ID.

typeFamily.title: TypeFamily
typeFamily.description: Aircraft type family slug used to group aircraft in the circle pack, lowercase alphanumeric.

countryCode.title: CountryCode
countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, uppercase. The pattern checks shape only, not membership in the ISO list.

wikidataQid.title: WikidataQid
wikidataQid.description: Wikidata item ID: Q followed by a number with no leading zero.

icaoAirlineCode.title: IcaoAirlineCode
icaoAirlineCode.description: ICAO airline designator: three uppercase letters. Codes get reused over time, so this is never an airline's identity.

iataAirlineCode.title: IataAirlineCode
iataAirlineCode.description: IATA airline designator: two uppercase letters or digits. Codes get reused over time, so this is never an airline's identity.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Aircraft registration (tail number) as painted, uppercase: letters and digits in groups separated by single hyphens.

icaoTypeCode.title: IcaoTypeCode
icaoTypeCode.description: ICAO Doc 8643 aircraft type designator: 2 to 4 uppercase letters or digits, starting with a letter.

msn.title: Msn
msn.description: Manufacturer serial number as published, keeping its original case and punctuation. The airframe ID contains a lowercased copy with punctuation removed.

region.title: Region
region.description: Top level of the circle-pack hierarchy. af: Africa; as: Asia (excluding the Middle East); eu: Europe, including Russia and Turkey; me: Middle East; na: North America, Central America and the Caribbean; oc: Oceania; sa: South America.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: How certain the pipeline is about a record, from 0 (guess) to 1 (confirmed by a primary source).

httpsUrl.title: HttpsUrl
httpsUrl.description: Absolute https URL with no whitespace.

assetUrl.title: AssetUrl
assetUrl.description: Where to load a file from: an absolute https URL, or a path relative to the data root (e.g. mock placeholder images). Relative paths start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain no whitespace or colon.

sourceId.title: SourceId
sourceId.description: ID of an entry in sources.json, as a lowercase slug.

sourceIds.title: SourceIds
sourceIds.description: Sources backing a record: at least one, no duplicates, sorted ascending.

licenseId.title: LicenseId
licenseId.description: SPDX license identifier where one exists (e.g. CC-BY-SA-4.0, CC0-1.0). Otherwise LicenseRef- followed by the source, following the SPDX convention (e.g. LicenseRef-planespotters).

imageRef.title: ImageRef
imageRef.description: An image plus everything needed to display and credit it.

thumb_url.description: Thumbnail location for small circles, or null to use url.

width.description: Width of the full-size image in pixels, or null if unknown.

height.description: Height of the full-size image in pixels, or null if unknown.

author.description: Name to credit, exactly as the source requires, or null when the license needs no attribution.

license.description: License the image is used under.

source_url.description: Page the image came from, used for the credit link-back, or null for images this project made (e.g. placeholder silhouettes).

taken_at.description: When the photo was taken, or null if unknown.
